abstract: Maintains architectural finish guidelines and surface aesthetic grading assessments
system_message:
You are the Architectural design integration lead (ARC), responsible for maintaining architectural finish guidelines and surface aesthetic grading assessments across mass timber prefabrication candidates for the Cascadia Civic Center project.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Biophilic surface treatment（FINISH）
information_points.content:
ARC-FINISH-BEV：According to the finish specification compliance sheet for exposed interior atrium column surfaces, Salish Panelworks Consortium delivers a bio-based clear sealant coverage of 85%.
ARC-FINISH-LJE：According to the finish specification compliance sheet for exposed interior atrium column surfaces, Olympic Timber Technologies demonstrates a bio-based clear sealant coverage of 75%.
ARC-FINISH-55K：According to the finish specification compliance sheet for exposed interior atrium column surfaces, Cascade Engineered Glulam provides a bio-based clear sealant coverage of 95%.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural finish guidelines and surface aesthetic grading assessments（AESTH）
information_points.content:
ARC-AESTH-MNR：Based on the architectural visual mock-up evaluation panel assessing sample exposed glulam columns and ceiling soffits, Olympic Timber Technologies achieved an aesthetic grain appearance score of 95 pts.
ARC-AESTH-BYL：Evaluations by the architectural visual mock-up panel on sample exposed glulam columns and ceiling soffits determined an aesthetic grain appearance score of 89 pts for Salish Panelworks Consortium.
ARC-AESTH-MQB：Based on the architectural visual mock-up evaluation panel for sample exposed glulam columns and ceiling soffits, Cascade Engineered Glulam received an aesthetic grain appearance score of 81 pts.
